# The Inward Lab

> Integrative life coaching in London and online with Alex Moudiotis: relationships and break-ups, boundaries and self-worth, purpose and career direction, confidence and emotional balance.

Founder: Alex Moudiotis, accredited Elite Life Coach (Level 5, IAPC&M), London. Sessions in London and online.
Contact: inwardlab@gmail.com

## Coaching areas
- [Relationship & break-up coaching](https://www.theinwardlab.com/relationships-breakup-coaching/): Relationship coaching with Alex Moudiotis is for people living through a break-up, or stuck in a relationship pattern that keeps repeating. Together you look at what happened, what it says about how you love and choose, and you take small, concrete steps towards relationships that feel steadier. Sessions take place in London or online.
- [Boundaries & self-worth coaching](https://www.theinwardlab.com/boundaries-self-worth-coaching/): Boundaries coaching is for people who say yes when they mean no, carry everyone else’s needs and feel worn out by it. With Alex Moudiotis you find where the pattern started, what it costs you now, and practise saying a clear, kind no in real situations. Sessions take place in London or online.
- [Purpose & career direction coaching](https://www.theinwardlab.com/career-purpose-coaching/): Career and purpose coaching is for people at a crossroads: a job that no longer fits, a move, a new field or a new chapter. With Alex Moudiotis you clarify what matters now, test options in the real world and turn a vague wish into a plan, in London or online.
- [Confidence & emotional balance coaching](https://www.theinwardlab.com/confidence-coaching/): Confidence coaching is for people who overthink, second-guess themselves or feel thrown by their emotions, even when life looks fine from the outside. With Alex Moudiotis you notice the patterns that knock you off-centre, build ways to steady yourself and practise speaking and acting from your own voice, in London or online.
